title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: M365 Copilot - Billing and usage - Usage insights
description: As you enable M365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing, AI administrators can view usage insights to inform agent management decisions. This feature displays the cost and number of messages in total and per agent. Cost and usage details can be filtered by billing policy and date range.
